items.title: Nightmare scenario as RBA outlines horror interest rates
items.description: The good news is the economy ended 2025 in relatively good shape — with growth starting to pick up, the economy transitioning away from government-led spending, and a historically strong jobs market. Unfortunately, that's where it ends.

items.title: ‘It could have caused many deaths’: Bomb attack condemned
items.description: Federal parliament officially condemns the attempted bomb attack at Perth's Invasion Day rally on its first sitting day, acknowledging the harm caused to the First Nations community.

items.title: Three Nationals banned from reunited Coalition cabinet until July under Ley's offer
items.description: Sussan Ley has given David Littleproud a list of non-negotiable conditions, which if accepted could see the Coalition reunited before the end of the week.

items.title: Mother says sending son to swim 4km for help 'one of the hardest decisions'
items.description: A WA mother says asking her teenage son to swim four kilometres through rough seas to get help after their family was swept out to sea, was "one of the hardest decisions" she has ever made.

items.title: Thousands of foreigners look for way home after 'mass exodus' from scam compounds
items.description: Cambodia has witnessed a "mass exodus" from the country's online scam operations in recent weeks amid growing international pressure and the extradition to China of an alleged kingpin.

items.title: What the newly released Epstein files say about Donald Trump
items.description: Donald Trump's name appears many times in the Epstein files — including on an FBI list of men who are named as subjects of "salacious information". So what have we learned about the US president?

items.title: Treasurer moves to restrict public access to company directors' home addresses
items.description: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission moves to dramatically restrict public access to the residential addresses of company directors at the request of Treasurer Jim Chalmers.

items.title: 'Existential threat' to Sydney Mardi Gras sees party dumped
items.description: Chief executive of the Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras, Jesse Matheson, announced the post-parade celebration will not go ahead.

items.title: Man accused of backing Bondi attackers faces more firearms charges
items.description: A Perth man who allegedly stated support for the Bondi shooters appears in court to face new firearms charges, with his lawyer flagging a bail application.

items.title: 'Beautiful' young Australian mourned as Japanese police investigate ski lift death
items.description: Queensland woman Brooke Day, 22, is being remembered as a "cherished teammate" following her death at a popular Japanese ski resort.

items.title: Family of Piper James arrive for farewell on island where she died
items.description: The parents and close friends of Piper James, 19, who died on K'gari (Fraser Island) last month, arrive in Australia to say their final farewells.

items.title: Inquiry hears toddler with 'persistent' scabies went undiagnosed for months
items.description: A 16-month-old child with "persistent" scabies did not receive a medical diagnosis for up to eight months due to inaction by Queensland's child safety department, an inquiry has heard.

items.title: Details of new $4 billion plan revealed for some kids with autism
items.description: The federal government has released the model for its Thriving Kids program, aimed at setting up services and supports run by states and territories outside the NDIS.

items.title: 'Grave concerns' for bushwalker missing in the Blue Mountains
items.description: Police have released an image of 71-year-old David Elliot as part of a multi-agency search when he failed to return from a 30-kilometre walk.

items.title: Could salty 'spas' and hot 'saunas' save the world's frogs from fungus?
items.description: Scientists are reintroducing hundreds of green and gold bell frogs into the ACT, nearly 50 years after they became locally extinct.

items.title: The small steps I have taken to better protect my mental health at work
items.description: I've spent my working life in what I like to call the "honesty gap".This kind of creative disclosure became a necessary art form to maintain my work life.

items.title: US Today show host's mother is missing in Arizona and authorities suspect an abduction
items.description: Police have declared a crime scene after the mother of US TV personality Savannah Guthrie went missing from her home. Here's what we know.

items.title: SA Parole Board says commissioner made 'error' in overturning Snowtown killer's release
items.description: New documents accuse the Parole Administrative Review Commissioner of making a mistake by not allowing the SA Parole Board to participate in a review of a decision to release Snowtown serial killer James Vlassakis.

items.title: NSW protest restrictions extended ahead of Israel president's visit
items.description: The NSW Police commissioner announces restrictions on protests will be extended, ahead of planned demonstrations against the upcoming Sydney visit of Israel's president.

items.title: Gold crashes after 'running on disaster scenario' that is yet to play out
items.description: The precious metals market collapses following the appointment of new US Federal Reserve chair Kevin Warsh, and some analysts say it signals a significant shift in the world's financial markets.

items.title: One Nation 'spot the Westerner' video condemned
items.description: A One Nation party official has filmed strangers on Melbourne's streets claiming the city "doesn't look like a Western nation at all".

items.title: Two alleged Brothers 4 Life members charged over gun possession
items.description: More than a decade after the gang wreaked havoc on Sydney's streets, two of its alleged members have been charged with firearms offences by the Raptor Squad.

items.title: Teachers face sack for hate speech in NSW classrooms, premier says
items.description: Teachers or school staff found to have breached bolstered NSW hate speech laws face tough sanctions, including the possibility of being fired.

items.title: Debut novel offers a frank depiction of reality as a high school teacher
items.description: Sita Walker, an English teacher from Brisbane, explains how she tackled her first work of fiction, set in a single hour at a state high school.

items.title: Police to conduct more firearms testing as part of Dezi Freeman search
items.description: Victoria Police is continuing to search bushland in the Mount Buffalo National Park for traces of alleged gunman Dezi Freeman.
